title: Reducible degree-three quotient is not an admitted field witness
situation: A degree-three simple number-field witness is replayed against an exact equation and open guard; the declared quotient must be a field.
attempted_conclusion: Accept the displayed cubic witness as a valid point.

expected.reason: a^3-a has a rational root and is reducible, so it cannot serve as the declared minimal polynomial of a simple field extension.

sources.anchor: Four additional controls accept a root of a^3-2
